use_cases.title: Begin checkout from the cart
use_cases.description: A shopper with a non-empty basket enters checkout from the cart, sees the available entry paths for an anonymous session, verifies that the checkout summary matches the cart totals, and can leave and return without losing basket contents.
use_cases.value: Keeps the purchase journey reachable and intact at the point where revenue conversion begins.

cite.quote: Checkout must be reachable and must not lose the basket.

criteria.text: From a non-empty cart, checkout entry is visible and clickable.

cite.quote: From a non-empty cart, the checkout entry point is visible and clickable.

criteria.text: An anonymous shopper is offered guest checkout and register/login options at checkout.

cite.quote: Checkout presents guest checkout and register/login options for an anonymous shopper.

criteria.text: The checkout order summary matches the cart totals exactly.

cite.quote: The order summary at checkout matches the cart totals exactly.

criteria.text: Leaving checkout and returning preserves basket contents.

cite.quote: Leaving checkout and returning preserves the basket contents.

use_cases.title: Review product details and add an item to the cart
use_cases.description: A shopper opens a product detail page to inspect buying information, must satisfy any required option selections before adding, receives confirmation when a valid product is added, and expects the chosen quantity to carry into the cart exactly as entered.
use_cases.summary: Inspect a product and add it correctly.
use_cases.value: Lets shoppers make a buying decision and place the intended item and quantity into the basket without corruption.

use_cases.title: Manage cart contents
use_cases.description: A shopper reviews the cart as the authoritative basket state, sees each added product with its pricing and quantity details, changes quantities with totals recalculated correctly, and can remove the final item into an explicit empty-cart state instead of an error state.
use_cases.summary: Review and edit the cart accurately.
use_cases.value: Protects basket integrity so shoppers can trust prices, quantities, and totals before checkout.

cite.quote: The cart must reflect exactly what the shopper chose, and must survive edits.

criteria.text: The cart lists every added product with unit price, quantity, and line total.

cite.quote: The cart page lists every added product with unit price, quantity and line total.

criteria.text: Each line total equals unit price times quantity.

cite.quote: Line total equals unit price times quantity.

criteria.text: Updating quantity recalculates the line total and the order total.

criteria.text: Removing the last item leaves the cart in an explicit empty state, not a broken page.

use_cases.title: Register a shopper account
use_cases.description: A new shopper submits registration details, is blocked on malformed email input or an unticked privacy policy with field-level errors and no account creation, and on valid unique details reaches an account-created confirmation state.
use_cases.value: Enables account-based shopping while preventing invalid or non-compliant registrations.

cite.quote: Returning shoppers must be able to authenticate; new shoppers must be able to register.

criteria.text: Registration rejects a malformed email address and an unticked privacy policy with a field-level error, and does not create the account.

cite.quote: Registration rejects a malformed email address and an unticked privacy policy

criteria.text: Registration with valid unique details lands on an account-created confirmation.

use_cases.title: Sign in to a shopper account
use_cases.description: A returning shopper authenticates with existing credentials, receives a warning on wrong credentials without disclosure of whether the email exists, and on success sees signed-in account navigation in the header.
use_cases.value: Restores account access securely without leaking account existence.

cite.quote: Returning shoppers must be able to authenticate; new shoppers must be able to register.

use_cases.title: Search for a product by name
use_cases.description: A shopper enters a product name from any page, can access the search control in the header on home and category pages, receives structured results for matching terms, receives an explicit no-match message for unsuccessful terms, and can revisit or share the results by URL.
use_cases.value: Helps shoppers quickly reach intended products without browsing through categories.

cite.quote: Shoppers must be able to find a product by name from any page.

use_cases.title: Switch displayed storefront currency
use_cases.description: A shopper changes the storefront currency and expects displayed prices to update consistently across the site rather than only on the current page.

use_cases.value: Improves price comprehension and trust for shoppers viewing the storefront in different currencies.

use_cases.title: Subscribe to the storefront newsletter
use_cases.description: A shopper submits an email address to the newsletter or subscribe control, succeeds with a valid email value, and is rejected on an invalid email value instead of being silently accepted.
use_cases.summary: Submit an email for newsletter subscription.
use_cases.value: Supports ongoing marketing reach while preventing obviously invalid subscriber data.
